original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: gke-cluster.jinja
- path: node-pool.jinja

resources:
- name: prod-gke-cluster
  type: gke-cluster.jinja
  properties:
    clusterName: prod-gke-cluster
    location: us-central1
    network: projects/$(ref.project.projectId)/global/networks/default
    subnetwork: projects/$(ref.project.projectId)/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/default
    podIpv4CidrBlock: 10.16.0.0/14
    servicesIpv4CidrBlock: 10.20.0.0/20
    masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
    masterAuthorizedNetworkCidr: 10.0.0.0/8
    releaseChannel: REGULAR
    minMasterVersion: "1.28"

- name: prod-node-pool
  type: node-pool.jinja
  properties:
    clusterName: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.name)
    location: us-central1
    nodePoolName: prod-node-pool
    machineType: e2-standard-4
    diskSizeGb: 100
    diskType: pd-ssd
    imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
    initialNodeCount: 1
    minNodeCount: 3
    maxNodeCount: 10
    serviceAccount: gke-node-sa@$(ref.project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com

outputs:
- name: clusterEndpoint
  value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.endpoint)
- name: clusterName
  value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.name)

---
# gke-cluster.jinja
resources:
- name: {{ properties["clusterName"] }}
  type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/locations/{{ properties["location"] }}
    cluster:
      name: {{ properties["clusterName"] }}
      description: Production GKE Standard cluster
      location: {{ properties["location"] }}
      initialClusterVersion: {{ properties["minMasterVersion"] }}
      releaseChannel:
        channel: {{ properties["releaseChannel"] }}
      network: {{ properties["network"] }}
      subnetwork: {{ properties["subnetwork"] }}
      loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        clusterIpv4CidrBlock: {{ properties["podIpv4CidrBlock"] }}
        servicesIpv4CidrBlock: {{ properties["servicesIpv4CidrBlock"] }}
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: false
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: {{ properties["masterIpv4CidrBlock"] }}
      masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
        enabled: true
        cidrBlocks:
        - displayName: internal-network
          cidrBlock: {{ properties["masterAuthorizedNetworkCidr"] }}
      networkPolicy:
        enabled: true
        provider: CALICO
      addonsConfig:
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        horizontalPodAutoscaling:
          disabled: false
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
        gcePersistentDiskCsiDriverConfig:
          enabled: true
      workloadIdentityConfig:
        workloadPool: {{ env["project"] }}.svc.id.goog
      shieldedNodes:
        enabled: true
      binaryAuthorization:
        evaluationMode: PROJECT_SINGLETON_POLICY_ENFORCE
      databaseEncryption:
        state: ENCRYPTED
      verticalPodAutoscaling:
        enabled: true
      maintenancePolicy:
        window:
          recurringWindow:
            window:
              startTime: "2024-01-01T03:00:00Z"
              endTime: "2024-01-01T07:00:00Z"
            recurrence: "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA,SU"
      nodePools:
      - name: default-pool
        initialNodeCount: 1
        management:
          autoUpgrade: true
          autoRepair: true

outputs:
- name: name
  value: {{ properties["clusterName"] }}
- name: endpoint
  value: $(ref.{{ properties["clusterName"] }}.endpoint)

# node-pool.jinja

- name: {{ properties["nodePoolName"] }}
  type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters.nodePools
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/locations/{{ properties["location"] }}/clusters/{{ properties["clusterName"] }}
    nodePool:
      name: {{ properties["nodePoolName"] }}
      initialNodeCount: {{ properties["initialNodeCount"] }}
      locations:
      - {{ properties["location"] }}-a

      - {{ properties["location"] }}-c
      autoscaling:
        enabled: true
        minNodeCount: {{ properties["minNodeCount"] }}
        maxNodeCount: {{ properties["maxNodeCount"] }}
      management:
        autoUpgrade: true
        autoRepair: true
      upgradeSettings:
        maxSurge: 1
